correctness.rationale: Each chart is identified with a polynomial factor times the rank-one 2-by-m determinantal semigroup using a complete monomial-generator description and all kernel relations via row-allocation swaps. Saturation proves normality. Its Jacobian has unique singular origin for m>=2. Projective support disjointness proves the union. Segre degree m yields local multiplicity; toric divisor class quotient Z and the canonical class (2,m) yield the Gorenstein/non-Q-Cartier threshold. Computation independently checks 100 charts and 28 Jacobian points but does not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The general toric/Segre and rank-one determinantal constructions are old, as are the complete multipartite edge polytopes and their smoothness classification.
